* '''PC-E1''' ([[Lothal: Advanced Projects Laboratory (Errata)]]): Card image published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/lothaladvancedprojectslaboratory.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/lothaladvancedprojectslaboratory.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: Once per turn, may deploy TIE Defender Project, Pryce, or Thrawn here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: Opponent may not reduce or cancel your Force drains here.” The E1 card image prints “Once per turn, may ▼ TIE Defender Project, Pryce, or Thrawn here.”; the PC card data has “Once per game, …” (the original's wording) — the image is followed here; question raised with Bill. '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If you control with a Rebel, Force drain +1 here.” became “Opponent may not reduce or cancel your Force drains here.” Dark Side text “Once per game, may deploy TIE Defender Project or Thrawn here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” became “Once per turn, may deploy TIE Defender Project, Pryce, or Thrawn here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
